text: Play no Green Shield cards when you've successfully completed a Green Rescue Contract..

name: Efficiency
text: Play no Yellow Thruster cards when you've successfully completed a Yellow Delivery Contract.

name: Fire Support
text: Play no Orange Damage cards when you've successfully completed an Orange Kill Contract.

name: Generalist
text: Have an Orange Magnomi, Green Henko, Blue Komek, and Yellow Ventus Ship Part simultaneously attached to your ship.

name: Gun for Hire
text: Successfully solo an Orange Kill Contract.

name: Megaton
text: Simultaneously have 3 Orange Magnomi Ship Parts attached to your ship.

name: Money Bags
text: Have 8 or more Credits at the very end of your turn (even if you failed the Contract)..

name: Natural Leader
text: Play at least 3 Crew Cards on the same Contract (even if you fail it).

name: Over 9000
text: Simultaneously have 3 or more Blue Komek Ship Parts attached to your ship.

name: Quick Run
text: Successfully solo a Yellow Delivery Contract.

name: Quick Strike
text: Play at least 3 Thruster cards on the same Contract.

name: Saboteur
text: Fail a Contract as an Ally (not a Mission Leader).

name: Santa Maria
text: Successfully solo a Blue Explore Contract.

name: Shield Wall
text: Play at least 3 Shield cards on the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

name: Specialist
text: Simultaneously have 2 or more Purple Sorelia Ship Parts attached to your ship.

name: Speed Demon
text: Simultaneously have 3 or more Yellow Ventus Ship Parts attached to your ship.

name: Tank
text: Simultaneously have 3 or more Green Henko Ship Parts attached to your ship.

name: Tinker
text: When you have 4 Ship parts attached to your Ship, replace one of them by purchasing a 5th Ship Part.

name: Utopia
text: Complete a Contract as a Mission Leader having every other player in the game participating in that Contract.

name: You're My Hero
text: Successfully solo a Green Rescue Contract.

name: Arsenal
text: Play 3 different types of Damage cards toward a single Contract (even if you fail it)..

name: IO-Adopter
text: Have 2 Crew and/or Ship Part cards with at least 1 IOsphere token on them.

name: IO-Hoard
text: Have a total of 6 IOsphere tokens on your Crew and/or Ship Part cards.

name: IO-Power
text: Spend 3 IOsphere tokens toward a single Contract (even if you fail it)..

name: Junker
text: Trash at least 2 cards toward a single Contract (even if you fail it)..

name: Parasite
text: Successfully complete a Contract without playing any cards.

name: Tactical
text: Play at least 2 Shield cards and 2 Damage cards on the same Contract (even if you fail it).

name: Technologic
text: Play 3 different types of Advanced Action cards toward the same Contract (even if you fail it).

name: Untouchable
text: Block 2 Hazard icons without playing a Shield on the same Contract (even if you fail it).

name: Weird Flex
text: Successfully solo a Flex Contract.

name: Alliance
text: Have 5 Faction Reputation with 1 Faction and 0 with all of the others.

name: Backup
text: Gain 4 or more Faction Reputation on the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

name: Brute
text: Fail a Contract as an Ally with a Mission Leader who either has the most Prestige or tied for the most Prestige.

name: Call In Favors
text: Spend 10 Faction Reputation toward a single Contract (even if you fail it).

name: For Hire
text: Spend Faction Reputation to get 2 Objectives when playing for the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

name: Freeloader
text: Join a Contract for no reward.

name: Hoarder
text: Have a total of 20 or more cards among your hand, draw pile, and discard pile.

name: Invest
text: Spend Faction Reputation to gain at least 3 Credits toward a single Contract (even if you fail it)..

name: Manifold
text: Spend Faction Reputation allowing you to draw 3 Cards on the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

name: Responsive
text: Spend Faction Reputation allowing you to gain 3 Actions on the same Contract (even if you fail it).

name: Advantageous
text: Trash a card during an Event.

name: Clandestine
text: Successfully solo a Contract on Sorelia.

name: Harmony
text: All players vote unanimously on a Policy.

name: Opulence
text: Simultaneously have 2 or more Purple Sorelia Prototype Ship Parts attached to your ship.

name: Benefactor
text: Take all of the Hazard Dice and none of the Credits on a Contract (even if you fail it).

name: Blessing
text: Roll at least 2 blank Hazard Dice during a Contract (even if you fail it).

name: Glare of Space
text: Roll 2 matching Hazard Dice toward a single Contract.

name: Ms. Fortune
text: Gain a Bonus Card that has a value of 4 or more Credits.

name: Royale
text: Gain a Bonus Card that has a value of 3 or more Credits.
